title: Canonical compatible term
statement: Given a DNF formula $\varphi$ on $n$ coordinates, a coordinate restriction $\rho$, and the assumption that at least one term of $\varphi$ is compatible with $\rho$, the canonical term is the term at the index selected by the formula's canonical-term rule for $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: At least one term of $\varphi$ is compatible with $\rho$
caveat: The definition of the canonical-term index is absent, so the rule selecting the term is unspecified.
